# ADR 0004: Hash-chained audit log

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Fraud case management service

## Context

Auditors must be able to detect altered or deleted audit records.

## Decision

Each audit row stores the SHA-256 of its content plus the previous row's hash; a verification endpoint walks the chain.

## Consequences

Tampering is detectable (not preventable); verification is linear in size.

## Alternatives considered

Plain audit table.
